tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mar me'i smon lam mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhugs so// rin chen dang po'i kong bu ni/ /stong gsum khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang / /rtsi mar bcud kyis yongs bkang ba'i/ /dkyil du sdong bu ri rab tsam/ /btsugs la sbar ba'i me lce yi/ /ngo bo ye shes lnga ldan la/ /rnam pa nyi ma dung phyur gyi/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba'i mar me 'dis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams kun khyab/ /'od kyi klong nas kun bzang gi /mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phro ba/ /srid mtha'i bar du rtag mchod pas/ /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs kyi/ /dmigs yul gshin gson ci mchis pa'i/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /ces pa'ang sga ston wā gin+d+ras gsungs so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ kyai rdor lam dus ma nor don gsal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
